name: Claude Agent
description: A panel where Claude reads and edits the open map with you: terrain, units, locations, doodads, sprites, fog, triggers, the mission briefing, strings, switches, players and forces, unit / upgrade / technology settings and the map's properties. Every change is one undo step. Runs on your own Anthropic API key, sent from this browser straight to the API (or to a proxy you name); no server of its own.
author: dro-coding
